name: MetisDAO
classificationNote: Classified by keyword rules from the SlowMist label and description.
rootCause: The official Twitter account of Ethereum expansion solution Metis was stolen. According to officials, team members fell victim to a Sim Swap attack, resulting in malicious actors being able to take over the account for approximately 30 hours.
